title: Links
summary: Render the root module’s document link descriptors.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: Takes no props and requires application context. Reads the links function from the root module.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: Renders one link element per descriptor returned by rootModule.links. With no links function, renders no link elements.

sections.title: Example
sections.body: Use this for stylesheets, icons, and resource hints declared by the application root. Keep deployment-specific asset URLs in the application.

sections.title: Scope
sections.body: Links does not discover fonts, generate CDN URLs, or load root data. Root links and route metadata are separate: route-level link descriptors can be returned by meta using tagName: "link".
